title: Complaint handling by District Commission
description: Handling of complaints by the District Commission

steps.step: District Commission refers a copy of the complaint to the opposite party, directing them to respond within 30 days or an extended period not exceeding 15 days
Opposite party responds to the complaint, either denying or disputing the allegations, or omits/fails to take action within the given time
District Commission proceeds to settle the consumer dispute based on evidence from the complainant and opposite party, or ex parte if the opposite party fails to respond
District Commission decides the complaint on merits if the complainant fails to appear on the date of hearing
